## Hi, I'm Damian Gallegos

I'm a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at The University of Texas at El Paso
working on **trustworthy machine learning**: quantifying uncertainty and
estimating error in neural networks, with a focus on
**Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)**.

[Email](mailto:dlgallegose@miners.utep.edu) ·
[GitHub](https://github.com/dlgallegose) ·
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8351-9977) ·
[CV (PDF)](files/cv.pdf)
:::

## Research

My research is in **machine learning**, with a primary focus on
**Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs)**, a neural network architecture that
replaces fixed activation functions on nodes with learnable activation
functions on edges. Current work:

- **Optimization for KANs.** Adaptive optimizer sequencing (L-BFGS first),
  validated with ablations against baselines, with open-source code.
- **Interpretability.** Turning trained KANs into readable mathematical
  formulas (Julia), so a model can be inspected rather than just trusted.
- **Confidence and error estimation.** Methods to estimate how confident a
  model is and how wrong it is likely to be, including Hessian-based analysis.
